purpose: Pre-registered predictions for iphone-01, written before the outcome is observable. scripts/verify.py scores them automatically once an analytics snapshot reaches the node. Do not edit a prediction after registration; add a new entry instead. Git history is the timestamp of record.

predictions.claim: VacVoltageLimit steps 4480 -> 4460 mV at the 250-cycle node, as the 200 node fired at exactly cycle 200.
predictions.metric: vac_voltage_limit_mv of the first snapshot with cycle_count >= 250

predictions.claim: NominalChargeCapacity drops by about one node step (0.43 pp = 16 mAh, as at the 200 node) across the 250 node.
predictions.metric: NCC of the last snapshot with cycle_count < 250 minus NCC of the first snapshot with cycle_count >= 250
predictions.note: Daily NCC jitter is <=2 mAh; the 126->152 and 194->208 steps were 15 and 16 mAh.

predictions.claim: The 250-cycle node is reached between the fastest and slowest measured usage windows (recent 30 days 1.53/day, recent 7 days 0.99/day). Point estimate at 1.30/day: 2026-12-17.
predictions.metric: date of the first snapshot with cycle_count >= 250
predictions.note: Snapshot dates lag the gauge write by up to one day.

predictions.claim: No prediction. Recorded so the outcome is noted either way: MaximumCapacityPercent stayed 101 across the 200 node.
predictions.metric: maximum_capacity_percent_reported of the first snapshot with cycle_count >= 250
